Exact Description: This Pokémon's attacks have a 30% chance of badly poisoning. This effect comes before a move's inherent secondary effect chance.

Name: Toxic Debris
Description: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: When this Pokémon is hit by a physical damaging move, places 1 layer of Toxic Spikes on the opposing side, up to 2 layers total. One layer poisons grounded opponents on entry; 2 layers badly poison them. Qualifying multi-hit attacks can add a layer with each hit. Normal hazard immunities and removal by grounded Poison types still apply.

Name: Trace
Description: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon's Ability.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Run the described effect once on deployment, targeting the stated units or battle field.
Exact Description: On switch-in, this Pokémon copies a random opposing Pokémon's Ability. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Teraform Zero, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Trace, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero. If no opposing Pokémon has an Ability that can be copied, this Ability will activate as soon as one does.

Name: Transistor
Description: Powers up Electric-type moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.3 (+30%) while using an Electric-type attack. Gen 8: the Electric offensive-stat multiplier was 1.5 (+50%) instead of 1.3 (+30%).

Name: Triage
Description: Gives priority to the Pokémon's healing moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described Speed or action-order rule in the battle scheduler, checking its stated condition.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.

Name: Truant
Description: Each time the Pokémon uses a move, it spends the next turn loafing around.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After this unit acts, skip its next scheduled action, then alternate between acting and loafing.
Exact Description: This Pokémon skips every other turn instead of using a move.

Name: Turboblaze
Description: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Skip the target ability checks for this unit move resolution.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokémon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokémon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokémon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokémon.

Name: Unaware
Description: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target's stat changes.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At the described trigger, modify the holder Attack through battle stat stages or an effective-stat modifier.
Exact Description: This Pokémon ignores other Pokémon's Attack, Special Attack, and accuracy stat stages when taking damage, and ignores other Pokémon's Defense, Special Defense, and evasiveness stat stages when dealing damage.

Name: Unburden
Description: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described Speed or action-order rule in the battle scheduler, checking its stated condition.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon loses its held item for any reason, its Speed is doubled (2x) as long as it remains active, has this Ability, and is not holding an item.

Name: Unnerve
Description: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.
Proposed: PROPOSED: While deployed, block opposing Berry activations in the item-trigger hook.
Exact Description: While this Pokémon is active, it prevents opposing Pokémon from using their Berries. This Ability activates before hazards and other Abilities take effect.

Name: Unseen Fist
Description: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After contact damage, run a post-hit reaction using the described chance, status, or ability-transfer effect.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's contact moves ignore the target's protection, except Max Guard.

Name: Vessel of Ruin
Description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: Active Pokémon without this Ability have their Special Attack multiplied by 0.75 (-25%).

Name: Victory Star
Description: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described accuracy or evasion change in attack hit-chance resolution under its stated condition.
Exact Description: This Pokémon and its allies' moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.1.

Name: Vital Spirit
Description: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Check the described immunity or prevention rule before applying the affected status, move, stat, or field effect.
Exact Description: This Pokémon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.

Name: Volt Absorb
Description: If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Intercept Electric hits before damage and restore HP using the ability description healing rule.
Exact Description: This Pokémon is immune to Electric-type moves and restores 1/4 (25%) of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by an Electric-type move.
Game Implementation: after getting hit with an electric move heal 25% of max hp

Name: Wandering Spirit
Description: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After contact damage, run a post-hit reaction using the described chance, status, or ability-transfer effect.
Exact Description: Pokémon making contact with this Pokémon have their Ability swapped with this one. Does not affect Pokémon with the Abilities As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

Name: Water Absorb
Description: If hit by a Water-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
Proposed: CURRENT RULES: Intercept Water hits and restore the configured fraction of maximum HP.
Exact Description: This Pokémon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 (25%) of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move.
Game Implementation: after getting hit with a water move heal 25% of max hp

Name: Water Bubble
Description: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves that hit the Pokémon and prevents it from being burned.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's offensive stat is doubled (2x) while using a Water-type attack. If a Pokémon uses a Fire-type attack against this Pokémon, that Pokémon's offensive stat is halved (0.5x) when calculating the damage to this Pokémon. This Pokémon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.

Name: Water Compaction
Description: Boosts the Defense stat sharply when the Pokémon is hit by a Water-type move.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add an incoming-hit hook; check the described move or damage condition, then apply its prevention, healing, or stat response.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's Defense is raised 2 stages after it is damaged by a Water-type move.

Name: Water Veil
Description: The Pokémon's water veil prevents it from being burned.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Check the described immunity or prevention rule before applying the affected status, move, stat, or field effect.
Exact Description: This Pokémon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.

Name: Weak Armor
Description: The Pokémon's Defense stat is lowered when it takes damage from physical moves, but its Speed stat is sharply boosted.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described Speed or action-order rule in the battle scheduler, checking its stated condition.
Exact Description: If a physical attack hits this Pokémon, its Defense is lowered by 1 stage and its Speed is raised by 2 stages. Gen 5-6: Speed rose by only 1 stage instead of 2.

Name: Well-Baked Body
Description: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add an incoming-hit hook; check the described move or damage condition, then apply its prevention, healing, or stat response.
Exact Description: This Pokémon is immune to Fire-type moves and raises its Defense by 2 stages when hit by a Fire-type move.

Name: White Smoke
Description: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Check the described immunity or prevention rule before applying the affected status, move, stat, or field effect.
Exact Description: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering this Pokémon's stat stages.

Name: Wimp Out
Description: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP becomes half or less.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At half HP or less, trigger a forced retreat if a legal reserve unit is available.
Exact Description: When this Pokémon has more than 1/2 (50%) its maximum HP and takes damage bringing it to 1/2 (50%) or less of its maximum HP, it immediately switches out to a chosen ally. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability. This effect applies to both direct and indirect damage, except Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, and confusion damage.

Name: Wind Power
Description: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add an incoming-hit hook; check the described move or damage condition, then apply its prevention, healing, or stat response.
Exact Description: When this Pokémon is hit by a wind move, or Tailwind starts on its side, it gains the charged effect. Its next Electric-type attack has double power (2x, a 100% increase). Using an Electric-type move other than Charge consumes the effect, even if it is a status move or misses. The effect otherwise persists until this Pokémon switches out. Repeated activation does not stack multipliers, and this Ability does not grant Charge's Special Defense stage increase.

Name: Wind Rider
Description: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add an incoming-hit hook; check the described move or damage condition, then apply its prevention, healing, or stat response.
Exact Description: This Pokémon is immune to wind moves and raises its Attack by 1 stage when hit by a wind move or when Tailwind begins on this Pokémon's side.

Name: Wonder Guard
Description: Its mysterious power only lets supereffective moves hit the Pokémon.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon can only be damaged by supereffective moves and indirect damage.
Game Implementation: Only Supereffective attacking moves can damage this pokemon(can still be affected by status moves)

Name: Wonder Skin
Description: Makes status moves more likely to miss the Pokémon.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described accuracy or evasion change in attack hit-chance resolution under its stated condition.
Exact Description: Non-damaging moves that check accuracy have their accuracy changed to 50% when used against this Pokémon. This effect comes before other effects that modify accuracy.

Name: Zen Mode
Description: Changes the Pokémon’s shape when HP is half or less.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At half HP or less, switch this unit to its registered alternate form and apply that form stats and types.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon is a Darmanitan or Galarian Darmanitan, it changes to Zen Mode if it has 1/2 (50%) or less of its maximum HP at the end of a turn. If Darmanitan's HP is above 1/2 (50%) of its maximum HP at the end of a turn, it changes back to Standard Mode.

Name: Zero to Hero
Description: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
Proposed: PROPOSED: When this unit leaves the field, change its party form to the registered Hero Form.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon is a Palafin in Zero Form, switching out has it change to Hero Form.
